source-integrity.rawDerivedConsistency: growth/RPO, roadmap, acquisition and valuation claims align with packet lineage

company-underwriting.financialOperatingTrajectory: Strong revenue/RPO growth but early commercialization, substantial losses and acquisition effects complicate organic attribution.
company-underwriting.balanceSheet: Substantial liquidity, but dilution and acquisition-led expansion increase capital-allocation risk.
company-underwriting.customersContracts: Deployments and RPO evidence demand; fault-tolerant workload economics remain unproven.
company-underwriting.governanceCapitalAllocation: Vertical integration and acquisitions broaden capability; long-duration returns remain unproven.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Differentiation exists but durable scarcity rent is not demonstrated.
company-underwriting.catalysts: Superion rollout, SkyWater integration and RPO conversion.

thesisQuality.basis: Commercial/RPO growth and integration support a credible thesis, but fault-tolerant economics remain unproven.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Growth is strong but losses and acquisition contribution reduce quality certainty.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Very high enterprise valuation relative to trailing revenue while profitability is absent.

catalystScore.basis: Superion, SkyWater integration and RPO conversion are identifiable catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Expanded scope and manufacturing control are offset by acquisition intensity, losses and dilution.

alignment2036.basis: Quantum compute/networking/sensing address durable strategic needs, with timing uncertainty.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Computing, networking, sensing and manufacturing provide several shared-platform demand channels.

bottleneckControl.basis: Vertical fabrication improves manufacturability control but fault tolerance/economic utility remain bottlenecks.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Platform breadth adds optionality, but adoption and roadmap execution remain central dependencies.

substitutionResilience.basis: Rival quantum modalities and classical accelerators remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: SkyWater integration improves domestic control but yield/redundancy are not demonstrated.

pricingPower.basis: Demand exists but durable price pass-through/scarcity rent is not established.

riskEvidence.basis: Valuation, losses, dilution, integration, roadmap uncertainty and substitutes create high risk.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current issuer and independent valuation evidence are adequate; independent technical benchmarks/yields and organic attribution remain incomplete.

scoreRecord.thesis: Real commercial growth and integrated manufacturing coexist with a valuation pricing substantial technical success before fault-tolerant economics are proven.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Roadmap or economic-advantage shortfalls could compress valuation sharply.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Superion deployment, SkyWater integration and RPO conversion.
